It may be noted that in earlier instances of non-compliance, stock exchanges had already waived off fine imposed on the Company upon attaining the requisite compliances.

operating_notes.text: RVNL emerged as L1 bidder for ₹221.33 Cr signaling and telecommunication EPC works under SECR Bilaspur Division with a 730-day execution window.
RVNL emerged as L1 bidder for ₹244.33 Cr (including taxes) traction upgrade EPC tender JBP-PROJECT-EPC-2025-01 from West Central Railway with an 18-month execution period.
Received ₹758.07 Cr LoA (including 18% GST) from NMDC for railway siding and civil works at Bacheli with a 36-month execution timeline.
Total outstanding receivable from Krishnapatnam Railway Company Limited (KRCL) stood at ₹1,116.26 Cr as on 31 March 2026, including ₹889.95 Cr accrued interest on delayed payment.
BSE fined RVNL ₹9,55,800 (incl. GST) for non-compliance with Regulations 17(1), 18(1) and 19(1)(2) on board and committee composition for the quarter ended 31 March 2026.
Order book stood at ₹99,262 crore as of March 31, 2026, driven by railways and multi-sector infrastructure.

Order book at 30 June 2026 was ₹93,492 Cr, split railways ₹58,000 Cr, S&P ₹12,000 Cr, ports/roads/highways ₹3,651 Cr, metros ₹5,700 Cr, power and transmission ₹4,000 Cr and hydro/irrigation ₹1,626 Cr.
About 42% of the order book is railway work awarded on a management-fee basis, and ₹6,500 Cr of work has come from NMDC on a PMC basis.
Railway receivables outstanding were about ₹2,500 Cr, with bills paid within 30 days per management.

RVNL signed an MoU with Damodar Valley Corporation for rail infrastructure and connectivity to DVC's power plants and captive coal mining areas, including RLS/CHP/SILO and re-tractable OHE systems, with no value stated.

timeline.summary: RVNL emerged as lowest bidder (L1) for a ₹221.33 Cr SECR electronic interlocking EPC project over 730 days.
RVNL emerged as lowest bidder (L1) for a ₹244.33 Cr traction sub-station EPC contract from West Central Railway over 18 months.
Received ₹758.07 Cr LoA (incl. GST) from NMDC for railway siding and civil works at Bacheli over 36 months.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6,695.91 Cr (+4.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹187.07 Cr.
Ministry of Railways declared President of India holds 150,874,369 shares of Rail Vikas Nigam Limited as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrance in FY2025-26.
BSE fined RVNL ₹9,55,800 (incl. GST) for board and committee composition non-compliance in Q4FY26; RVNL said only the Ministry of Railways appoints directors and it will seek a waiver.
RVNL held its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 26, 2026, reporting an order book of ₹99,262 Cr and guiding for 15-20% revenue growth in FY27.

On 15 October 2026, RVNL signed a non-binding MoU with Damodar Valley Corporation for rail connectivity, rapid loading systems and OHE at DVC's power plants and captive coal mines, with no value stated.
